features.quote: About 20 m south of the northern enclosure ... apparently a tumulus.

date.basis: not dated by the entry (site period list does not date the component)

notes: Only possible grave is a round structure 'apparently a tumulus', 20 m S of the northern enclosure (direction from another feature, so relative_to other). Coded as a grave because a tumulus is a burial mound; the entry does not call it a tomb. No pool or pit; no plan. 'Cisterns: none' recorded as C2 absence.
